def equation(eps, T, params):
    L = np.log(T)
    A = params[0] + params[1]*np.exp(-params[2]/T) + params[3]*L + params[4]*T + params[5]/T
    B = params[6] + params[7]*L + params[8]/T + params[9]*L**2
    return A + B*eps**2
